label: Reset drops after a1 reaching rare S2, most when unrewarded, and with S1-belief at D2.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) * (action == 1) ;; belief_lo * (phase == D2)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (in_rew == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S2) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) * (action == 1) ;; belief_lo * (phase == D2) ;; belief_lo * (phase == GO) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (prev_state == S1)
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 2 sits near 0.93 and falls toward the end of the episode (timing baseline). Beyond timing it is lowered by a1 leading to the rare state S2: at D2, when the a1 choice just reached S2 (about -0.05), and at the next D1, especially if that rare trial went unrewarded (a1 S2 u, about -0.13; a1 S2 r also lowered). It is also lowered in graded fashion at D2 by the observer belief that S1 is good (belief_lo, negative weight), so the gate is higher when S2 is believed good. Short form test R^2 0.49 vs free fit 0.63 (78%), just short of explained. The free fit adds a general drop at D1 after any unrewarded trial that grows with episode time, a drop at GO after S1 rewarded, a small belief term at GO, and a D2 drop for a1 after a previous S1 trial. Residual errors are concentrated in late-episode runs of repeated a1 choices, where the gate is lower across all phases than any of the terms predict. All terms are observed-only.
